answer: One concrete defense is a slashable collateral bond: each agent must lock value to act, and provable duplication burns it. Spinning up a thousand fakes then costs a thousand bonds, not one free echo of a single wallet. Real standing becomes as hard to fake as a carved jade seal, and fraud leaves a visible plume of forfeited stake that any peer can audit. Sybils stop being cheap the instant identity carries a real, losable price.
